Hi there! I'm Nathalie Bonnet (silent h, pronounced like Bo-nay. C'est français!). I am an environmental data scientist-in-training at UCSB's Bren School of Environmental Science and Management. I feels equally at home in the field studying pollinators and wrangling metadata in R. Beyond the keyboard, you can usually find me chasing sunshine on a trail, bike, or surfboard!
